verdict.rationale: Whether source code is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS financial-data product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Stripe Financial Connections publishing its source under any open license. The docs cover APIs, webhooks, an MCP server and a CLI, but none of these is open-source product code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
